title: FMC Corporation CEO Pierre Brondeau and CFO Andrew Sandifer to speak at J.P. Morgan Industrials Conference
summary: FMC Corporation (NYSE: FMC) today announced that Pierre Brondeau, FMC chairman, chief executive officer and president, and Andrew Sandifer, FMC executive vice president and chief financial officer, will speak at the J.P. Morgan Industrials conference on March 18, 2026, at 10:05 a.m. Eastern Time. A live webcast will be available at www.fmc.com/investors
body_markdown:
FMC Corporation (NYSE: FMC) today announced that Pierre Brondeau, FMC chairman, chief executive officer and president, and Andrew Sandifer, FMC


executive vice president and chief financial officer, will speak at the J.P. Morgan Industrials conference on March 18, 2026, at 10:05 a.m. Eastern Time. A live webcast will be available at


[www.fmc.com/investors](http://www.fmc.com/investors)
